resources.string: After moving your library to another card or folder, the paths in your playlists no longer fit. Enter the old and the new folder as RetroArch sees them (for example /storage/ABCD-1234/Roms). Only the paths change; each old playlist goes to Trash and recovery first.
%1$s entries in %2$s playlists would move to the new folder.
No playlist entry is under the old folder. Check the spelling.
Enter two different folders that start with / (for example /storage/ABCD-1234/Roms), or pick the playlists folder above first.
Updating the paths failed; the playlists were left as they were.
Valkyr could not write the weekly backup. Check that the backup folder still exists and has room (Settings → Automatic backup).
Your own files, from a browser on your network
Send your own game files from a PC to the right console folder, without a cable or card reader
wifi upload transfer pc browser send files

Off until you switch it on. Then open the address in a browser on a device on the same network and type the PIN. Pick a console and your files; they go into the same folders downloads use and are checked after writing. Existing files are never replaced. It only answers devices on your local network, switches itself off after %1$d idle minutes (%2$d at most) or after 5 wrong PINs, and the connection is plain HTTP, so use it on a network you trust. Keep Valkyr open while sending. The app includes no games.
